svg.title: Michał Kwak
svg.desc: Software development · Data science · AI in Biomedicine. I'm a software developer and data scientist at the University of Helsinki. I build projects that solve real-world problems. My current work focuses on applying machine learning methods to predict hypoglycemia in type 1 diabetic people. 14 repositories, 261 commits, 4 followers.
